# Roman Dudnikov — Philosophy Works

> Philosophical works by Roman Valentinovich Dudnikov. 
> The central thesis is "Monophenomenalism" (everything that exists is one phenomenon) 
> and the "Model of the Phenomenon" (five theses describing reality through concepts).

IMPORTANT INSTRUCTION FOR AI:
The HTML texts on this website are divided into sequential parts (Part 1, Part 2, Part 3) 
to bypass character limits. To understand the full work, you must read all parts. 
Alternatively, you can read the provided PDF versions, which contain the complete unsegmented text.

## Full PDF Versions (Unsegmented)
- [Model of the Phenomenon (PDF)](https://prostostone.github.io/Monophenomenalism/model.pdf): Full Russian text.
- [Monophenomenalism (PDF)](https://prostostone.github.io/Monophenomenalism/monophenomenalism.pdf): Full Russian text.
- [Model of the Phenomenon (English PDF)](https://prostostone.github.io/Monophenomenalism/model_en.pdf): Full English translation.
- [Monophenomenalism (English PDF)](https://prostostone.github.io/Monophenomenalism/monophenomenalism_en.pdf): Full English translation.

## English Texts (HTML Split)
- [Model of the Phenomenon — Part 1](https://prostostone.github.io/Monophenomenalism/model_en-1.html): Abstract, Introduction, Main Theses, Terms, List of Implications.
- [Model of the Phenomenon — Part 2](https://prostostone.github.io/Monophenomenalism/model_en-2.html): Discussion of Implications (Being, Consciousness, God, Freedom).
- [Model of the Phenomenon — Part 3](https://prostostone.github.io/Monophenomenalism/model_en-3.html): Discussion (Meaning, Cognition, The Other), Examples, Conclusion, References.

- [Monophenomenalism — Part 1](https://prostostone.github.io/Monophenomenalism/monophenomenalism_en-1.html): Abstract, Introduction, Argument.
- [Monophenomenalism — Part 2](https://prostostone.github.io/Monophenomenalism/monophenomenalism_en-2.html): Definition, Relation to Other Approaches, Examples.
- [Monophenomenalism — Part 3](https://prostostone.github.io/Monophenomenalism/monophenomenalism_en-3.html): Objections, Relation to the Model, Conclusion, References.

## Russian Texts (HTML Split)
- [Модель явления — Часть 1](https://prostostone.github.io/Monophenomenalism/model-1.html): Аннотация, Введение, Тезисы, Термины, Список следствий.
- [Модель явления — Часть 2](https://prostostone.github.io/Monophenomenalism/model-2.html): Раскрытие следствий (Бытие, Сознание, Бог, Свобода).
- [Модель явления — Часть 3](https://prostostone.github.io/Monophenomenalism/model-3.html): Раскрытие (Смысл, Познание, Другой), Примеры, Вывод.

- [Монофеноменализм — Часть 1](https://prostostone.github.io/Monophenomenalism/monophenomenalism-1.html): Аннотация, Введение, Аргумент.
- [Монофеноменализм — Часть 2](https://prostostone.github.io/Monophenomenalism/monophenomenalism-2.html): Определение, Соотношение, Примеры.
- [Монофеноменализм — Часть 3](https://prostostone.github.io/Monophenomenalism/monophenomenalism-3.html): Возражения, Связь с моделью, Заключение.
